purpose: Repeat the unchanged four-annulus RX J2129 BCG reconstruction with a template library whose native resolution is finer than MUSE throughout the fitted rest-frame range.
amendment_reason: The E-MILES templates used in protocol 0.1 have FWHM 2.51 Angstrom over 3935-5798 Angstrom rest frame, while the 2.5-2.7 Angstrom observed MUSE range corresponds to 2.024-2.186 Angstrom rest frame. pPXF clips negative resolution differences, making the E-MILES instrumental-resolution sensitivity grid non-informative. XSL has 0.402-0.592 Angstrom FWHM over the same range and permits valid forward convolution.
post_result_disclosure: The full-annulus XSL 2.6-A, 6-sigma sensitivity values were generated during the invalidated covariance-0.1 run before this amendment. System selection, center, annuli, mask construction, half-field checks, and numerical thresholds remain unchanged from protocol 0.1; the corrected half-field results and XSL bootstrap covariance were not inspected before this file was frozen.
blindness_rule: No gravity residual or lensing mass residual is used. The correction is forced by template and instrument resolution metadata, not by the direction or size of a kinematic result.

input.astrometric_registration: fit the unchanged fixed-n=4.05 circular continuum model and treat the offset from the published BCG center as a global cube-WCS correction

mask_protocol.stage_1: mask non-finite DATA/STAT values and non-positive variance
mask_protocol.stage_2: construct a white-light image from the median over 6000-7000 Angstrom
mask_protocol.stage_3: subtract a 3-pixel Gaussian-smoothed white-light image to form a compact-source detection image
mask_protocol.stage_4: flag positive compact residual components above 6 robust sigma with 2-300 connected pixels, excluding the registered central 3.0 arcsec
mask_protocol.stage_5: dilate flagged components by 8 pixels and freeze the mask before spectral fitting

spectral_fit.mask_high_variance_pixels: exclude wavelength planes whose annular variance median exceeds the local 21-pixel median by 6 robust sigma
spectral_fit.noise_model: sum STAT variance over unmasked spaxels and rescale conditional pPXF errors by square root of reduced chi-square

covariance_protocol.spatial_resampling: 100 deterministic spatial block-bootstrap replicates within each annulus using anchored 2x2-spaxel blocks
covariance_protocol.template_systematic: retain the E-MILES difference only as a conservative template-plus-resolution mismatch diagnostic; use XSL for the resolution-valid baseline and bootstrap
